text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 75 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea, east of Australia, near 12.8s/155.3e, moving west-southwest at 5 mph. Justin will weaken very little over the next 48 hours. During this time, the storm will slow down and may become nearly stationary. Shipping continues to be threatened by this system.

Tropical Cyclone Hina, with 70 mph winds, is in the Southern Pacific Ocean near 23.8s/174.6w, moving southeast at 22 mph. Hina is expected to weaken and lose tropical characteristics during the next 48 hours, while moving rapidly southeastward. The storm threatens only shipping.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
